questions.prompt: What did 2004 Finals MVP Chauncey Billups average in points per game?

questions.note: 21.0 per game for the Finals MVP, on 50.9% shooting.

funFacts.text: Billups was exceptionally efficient during the title run, shooting over 47% from three.
The Lakers entered the matchup favored, with a lineup led by Kobe Bryant and Shaquille O'Neal.

questions.prompt: After years of injuries, Derrick Rose's emotional Halloween 2018 comeback against Utah ended with how many points?

questions.note: 50 points. Rose blocked Utah's last attempt, then left the court in tears.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
